Messages.Author: LSJ (VtES Rep)
Messages.Body:
Rulings
=======

Terminology

* "A Set of ItemX" means one or more ItemX. [RTR 960112]
* "Controlled" is synonymous with "in the Active Region".
[RTR 960124]
* "Uncontrolled" is synonymous with "in the Inactive
Region". [RTR 960124]
* "During phase X, do Y" limits Y to once per phase X.
:T03: [LSJ 970625]
* "During a political action" means during the resolution
(the voting process) [LSJ 970630]

Library/Hand/Ash Heap

* If your hand size is reduced, immediately discard down
to your new maximum hand size. [TOM 951212]
* At the end of a combat (and after an action), replace
any "do not replace until after combat" cards that have
been played. [TOM 960413]
* Cards that go into an ash heap, hand, or library always
go into their owner's ash heap, hand, or library.
[RTR 970425]

Playing Cards

* All cards are shown when played, incl. equipment,
strikes, and political actions. [RTR]
* You cannot pay part of a cost. If, between the time a
card is played and the time the cost is paid, you no
longer can pay the cost, then no cost is paid and the
card is burned without effect. [TOM 960514]

Controlled Cards

* A card with a clan symbol only requires a ready member
of that clan *when played*. You don't need a clan member
to gain control of the card (via Far Mastery, Disputed
Territory, etc.) once it's in play. [TOM 960226]
* You cannot move a card onto something that it can't
normally be played on. [RTR 970630]

Vampires/Crypt/Uncontrolled Region

* Caitiff are clanless. [RTR 941109]
* If a vampire changes Clans, it retains all other
Characteristics it had before the switch. This includes
any titles (Justicar, Prince, etc.). EXCEPTIONS: Sect
(Camarilla/Non-Camarilla) is changed to the new Clan's
sect. Clan-based capacity (e.g., from a Seized Praxis)
is removed (or added) based on the new clan.
[RTR 960708]

Master Cards

* If you steal a location, treat it as if you had just
brought it into play. (you may retarget Tomb of Ramses,
for instance). [RTR 961113]
* The effect of the Master Card is completely defined when
the card is played (any targets must be named).
[LSJ 970630]

Actions

* The card used for an action is shown when the action is
announced (for equipping, recruiting, employing, calling
a vote, etc.) [RTR]
* If a minion cannot pay the cost of an action when the
action resolves, the action continues with no effect.
[RTR 961113]
* Since bleeds of zero are unsuccessful actions [RTR], the
cost of the action (if any) is not paid. [LSJ 971217]
* Any action which retrieves an equipment card and says to
'equip' the acting minion with that card is considered
an 'equip action'. [TOM 960130]
* If the methuselah loses control of the acting minion
before the action is successful, then the action ends.
[RTR 970630]
* Cards and abilities that are usable only after a
successful action are used after the action is
completed, including any oustings. [RTR 970630]

Directed actions

* Only actions specified as directed in the rules or with
a (D) symbol are directed. [RTR]
* Directed actions cannot be directed against yourself, or
cards under your control, unless apparent from card
text. [TOM 951215]

Terminology

* "Same Action" means: 1) The same inherent (cardless)
action taken against the same target. 2) The action
taken with the same card played from hand, regardless of
target. 3) The same action provided by the same copy of
a card in play. (Each action provided by a card in play
is a distinct action (and doesn't count as the "same
action"). :T02: [RTR 950905]
* "Same Type of Action" means: 1) One of the types of
actions defined in the rulebook (6.4, 7, and 19),
includined action card versions. 2) An action that is
not defined in the rulebook is a "type" based on the
card played to take the action, or a type unique to the
instance of the card in play that granted the ability to
take the action. [RTR]

Blocking

* If the target of a directed action is reset, a new
"choose blockers" opportunity results. :B02:
[RTR 970630]
* Combat occurs *after* the block - not as a part of it.
[RTR 950530]

Retainers

* Retainers are never optional. [RTR 950509]
* If damage is dealt to a retainer outside of combat, this
permanently reduces the retainer's life. [TOM 951209]
* If a retainer which requires a discipline to be employed
is brought into play by a means other than "Employ
Minion", treat it as if it were brought into play with
the basic version of the Discipline. :R01: [RTR 960221]
* Any reference to the employing vampire should be a
reference to the employing minion, unless the retainer's
ability clearly only applies to a vampire. [RTR 960530]

Equipment

* Equipment is always optional. [RTR 950509]
* Equipment is always optional only as the equipment
affects the bearer. Other effects (such as Talbot's
Chainsaw's untap damage and Incriminating Videotape's
affect on the minion who can't block) are not optional.
[LSJ 971022]
* Equipment only applies while in possession. If needed
for an action, the action will fizzle if the acting
minion doesn't possess the equipment when the action
resolves. :E01: [RTR 960221]

Action Modifiers/Reactions

* Action modifiers cannot be played by a vampire in torpor
unless that vampire is the acting minion. [RTR 970306]
* Reaction cards cannot be played a vampire in torpor.
[RTR]

Combat

* Combat cannot occur in Torpor. [FAQ 950925]
* Minions of the same controller cannot enter combat with
each other. [RTR 970630]
* A manuever or press gained by a combat card can only be
used during the current round of combat. A maneuver or
press gained by a non-combat card (e.g., action,
equipment) can be used in any round of the combat.
[TOM 960521]
* If an effect "sets" the range of a round (and therefore
skips the maneuver phase), no other effect can be used
to reset the range. [RTR 970630]
* A vampire burned in combat does not pass through Torpor.
[RTR 941109]
* Cards which are not usable by vampires going to Torpor
only check to see if the vampire is currently going to
torpor, not if the vampire will be going to Torpor
later. E.g., A vampire with Undead Persistence can still
play these types of cards. [LSJ 970304]
* Hand Strike: any non-ranged, non-weapon strike that
deals damage based on the striking minion's hand damage,
or any minion's non-ranged damage-dealing innate strike.
[LSJ 970224]
* Allies without non-ranged damage-dealing innate strikes
have no hand strike (not even for zero damage).
[RTR 950209 LSJ 970917]
* If the strike does something in addition to ending
combat, that something takes place just after the combat
ends. :C03: [RTR 970630]
* Dodges only neutralize the opposing strike's effects on
the dodging minion and any non-retainer cards on him.
:C01: [TOM 960403]
* If you steal blood that brings you over your capacity,
you still steal all of the blood. The part about the
excess going to the blood bank is just a reminder of
what to do when blood exceeds capacity. [LSJ 970707]
* You can gain additional strikes even if you cannot
strike. You still cannot strike with the additional
strike, however. [LSJ 970821]

Damage (Combat)

* Damage is only considered to have come from a minion if
the damage is from a strike or if an effect specifically
states that the damage is dealt by the minion. Damage
from other effects is considered "environmental," and
has no particular source. :C02: [RTR 970630]
* The damage modifier must be played before the end of the
Choose Strike phase in order to affect the current
strike. [RTR 960112]
* Ammo cards are played before any strikes take effect
regardless of whether those strikes deal damage or not.
Thus, if a vampire who plays Dragon's Breath Rounds is
targetted by Rotschreck, the combat will end before
either strike does anything. [RTR 960221]
* Adding damage to strikes which are not damage dealing
strikes will not deal damage (e.g., using Lucky Blow and
choosing your Rowan Ring melee weapon won't deal damage)
[RTR 960221]
* Additional damage inherets all of the properties of the
base damage (So the +1 damage from lucky blow is
aggravated for Basilia). [RTR]
* The base damage does not inheret the properties of the
additional damage (So a Saturday Night Special with
Dragon's Breath Rounds does 1 normal plus 2 aggravated
damage). [RTR]
* Effects that increase the damage provided by strike
cards affect those cards rather than the striking minion
(so the added damage is the same type as the strike's
damage, not the base damage). [RTR 970630]

Voting

* The is no rigid order enforced for casting votes.
Methuselahs (and their minions) can cast their votes at
any time, in any order. [LSJ 970714]
* A Methuselah can abstain for as long as she likes before
casting her votes, up to the 15-second (out-loud) time
limit after the last vote is cast. [LSJ 970714]
* A vampire can only have one title. If it is given
another one, the old title is ignored, even if the new
title would be a demotion. [RTR 941109]
* Allies can vote, if they manage to get votes (from
Alamut, for example). [TOM 960205]

Contesting

* Contested Vampires are out of the game except wrt their
titles. A contested Vampire with a contested Title must
yield the Title. [RTR 960221]
* Unique cards on Contested cards are out of the game
except wrt being Contested. They are Contested as
normal, should the need arise. [RTR 960221]

Torpor and Diablerie

* Only vampires can commit diablerie. Effects that would
allow something other than a vampire to commit diablerie
are ignored. [RTR 970630]
* Only one Blood Hunt vote can be called for a given
diablerie. [RTR 960114]
* "Wild Hunt" [SAB] is another name for Blood Hunt. [RTR]
* If an event (like successful Return to Innocence [AH]
with Day Operation) both burns and torporizes a vampire,
the controller decides whether the vampire will go into
torpor before being burned. [RTR 960708]
* Vampires in Torpor can still commit diablerie, if the
opportunity presents itself (in torpor after a Kiss of
Ra when blocking a leave torpor action, for example).
[RTR 970425]
* A vampire blocking a leave torpor action can diablerize
that vampire even if the blocking vampire is burned or
goes to torpor. [RTR 970630]

3rd Tradition: Progeny, The - Action (Prince/Justicar) (1)

* The vampire created is of the same clan as the acting
vampire. [RTR 941109]

Anarch Troublemaker - Unique Master

* May be used to tap one or two vampires your prey
controls. [RTR 950413]

Archon - Political Action P/J

* If a vampire blocks an Archon, he or she burns 1 blood
regardless of which action the Archon was taking. (The
use of the semi-colon in the V:TES text implies that the
point of blood is burned only when the Archon is using
his or her rush ability.) [RTR 960221]

Astrid Thomas - Vampire (Tre) (7)

* Tremere who have not yet voted can choose to abstain.
[RTR 941006]
* If her votes are canceled by an effect such as Pulled
Strings, the other Tremere votes remain as they were.
[RTR 960530]

Betrayer - Master

* Each of their turns, the person subjected to Betrayer
can name a vampire. If the guess is correct, Betrayer is
burned. [RTR 941109]
* If the vampire chosen for Betrayer is burned, so is
Betrayer. If the vampire chosen for Betrayer becomes
contested, Betrayer is nullified until the contention is
resolved, at which time the Betrayer is reactivated. If
a player takes control of the vampire that is the target
of the betrayer, that player takes the pool loss.
[RTR 941109]

Black Cat - Vampire (Bru) (5)

* The lower pool cost is used for the "cost" of equipment
on her. [RTR 941109]
* Does not reduce the cost of Equipment paid for with
blood instead of pool [RTR 960112]

Bomb - Equipment (1)

* When taking the action to burn a location, the action
will fail if the acting minion does not possess the bomb
when the action resolves (after being Masked, or if the
Bomb was transferred or destroyed somehow). :E01:
[RTR 960221]

Brujah Frenzy - Master Out-of-Turn

* Must select a "ready, untapped minion" to send the
Brujah into combat with. If there are no such minions,
Brujah Frenzy cannot be played. [RTR 951110]
* While it may be played any time a valid target minion
exists, it will not cause combat if combat cannot occur
(e.g., the Brujah is attempting the 'leave torpor'
action). The target minion is still tapped. [RTR 951110]

Business Pressure - Action Modifier (ps)

* Can only be used during a political action. [RTR 941109]
* Each Methuselah must decide how much pool to burn for it
during the resolution of the effect. It does not give an
ability for the rest of the political action. However,
there can be some give and take during the resolution of
the effect. For example, each Methuselah can choose to
burn one pool at a time as pool is burned for votes.
[RTR 960530]

Chantry - Master: Unique Location (Tre)

* Using the Chantry is optional. [RTR 941222]

Charming Lobby - Action (ps)

* This card requires three vampires to be effective: one
to play Charming Lobby, another to call the first vote,
and the third to call the second vote. Only votes which
are successfully called apply. [RTR 950413]
* A bloodhunt vote does not qualify. [TOM 950921]

Charnas the Imp - Retainer (Tre) (1)

* Cannot be damaged by host, but does not stop host from
using effects which would normally damage it. For
example, the host can use Body of Sun, but would not
damage Charnas as a result. [RTR 941109]

Cryptic Rider - Action Modifier (1)

* May only be used after a referendum is successful, not
simply a successful political action (unblocked vote).
[RTR 950209]

Dawn Operation - Action Modifier (fo)

* Should be read as "If the acting vampire is blocked..."
[RTR 941109]

Delaying Tactics - Reaction

* Cancels the political action, but the acting minion is
still considered to have taken a political action (for
purposes of the "No Repeat Action" rule, if used).
[RTR 970630]

Deflection - Reaction (do) (1)

* Cannot be used to direct a bleed to a Methuselah who
would be an invalid target for a bleed (after Minor
Boon, e.g.) [RTR 950622]
* Can be used to redirect the bleed to yourself, thereby
granting you another opportunity to block. :B02:
[RTR 970630]

Disarming Presence - Action Modifier (ps)

* Vampires are tapped when they cast their votes.
[RTR 970425]

Domain Challenge - Political Action

* Tapped minions are counted after the vote is completed.
[RTR 941109]

Eagle's Sight - Reaction (au)

* Only affects the rule restricting who gets to block an
action. The vampire must still meet all other
requirements to block (intercept, etc.) In particular,
Blood Bond, Day Operation, and Seduction are not
circumvented. [RTR 950413]
* Must be played during the 'choose blockers' stage. It
may not be used after the action Methuselah asks for
"all other blocking attempts". It may be used after your
normal position on the choose blocker list (i.e., Prey -
Predator - Prey w/ Eagle's sight). [TOM 960106]

Effective Management - Master

* Pulls a vampire from the *top* of the Crypt - it in no
way allows you to look through your Crypt to select a
vampire to pull. [TOM 950421]

Elder Kindred Network - Reaction (Ven)

* Has no effect on a successful Referendum. [TOM 951006]

Elysium: Arboretum, The - Master: Unique Location

* May not be used if you have no minions in the combat.
[VtES]

Embrace, The - Action (2)

* The vampire created is of the same clan as the acting
vampire. [RTR 941109]

Enchant Kindred - Action (ps)

* Superior may ONLY be used in your own uncontrolled
region. [RTR 960530]

Flesh of Marble - Combat (pt)

* Prevents all damage *that was not prevented* in excess
of one point. [RTR 950209]

Form of Mist - Combat (pt)

* The superior version can be used by a blocking vampire,
but this will not cause the action to be continued.
[RTR 941109]
* The superior version only continues the action if it is
played by the acting minion. [LSJ 970224]

Ghoul Retainer - Retainer (2)

* Read as "Each round of combat, Ghoul uses hands for 1
damage or a weapon of the employing minion that the
minion is not presently using." [RTR 941109]
* More than one Ghoul Retainer employed by a Minion could
"use" the same weapon (that the Minion is not using) at
the same time. [TOM 950921]
* The Ghoul is never the "bearer" of the weapon that it
uses. Any side-effect of using the weapon (e.g. Zip Gun,
Grenade) is applied to the Employing minion, as normal.
[TOM 951114]

Glaser Rounds - Combat

* Must wait until the second time a given gun is used in a
given combat. [RTR 941109]

Govern the Unaligned - Action (do) (1)

* Superior may ONLY be used in your own uncontrolled
region. [RTR 960530]

High Stakes - Political Action (Ven)

* The last two sentences are talking to each player, not
just the player playing High Stakes. [RTR 941109]

Hunting Grounds - Master. Unique Location (Clan) (2)

* All Hunting Grounds should be read as "received by a
given vampire", not "given to a vampire". [RTR 941109]

Immortal Grapple - Combat (po)

* The "only hand strikes" effect lasts for the entire
combat. [TOM 951113]
* If a minion is commited to using a strike other than a
hand strike (e.g., used a maneuver from a gun), then he
gets no strike. [TOM 951217]

Kindred Society Games - Master (Tor)

* The last sentence is vague. Replace it with "If the
vampire doesn't untap but instead moves the Society
Games on, but there is no tapped younger vampire to move
it to, Society Games is burned instead." [RTR 941109]

Life Boon - Master: Out-of-Turn

* If a player is saved more than once by Life Boon, the
various Boons reserve a series of victory points (and
ante), rather than competing with each other for a
single victory point and ante. [RTR 951017]
* If a player has gone to negative pool, the Life Boon
player must give her enough pool to compensate for that.
[RTR 970630]

Madness Network - Unique Master (Mal)

* Reaction Cards can be played is response to another
Methuselah's action on your own turn. Action cards and
action modifiers can be played whenever you take an
action, even when it is not your turn. [RTR 970630]
* Malkavians may block *in addition* to the normally
eligible blockers. [RTR 950530]

Magic of the Smith - Action (th) (1)

* Costs are paid for with either pool or minion blood, as
appropriate (VtES card text makes this explicit).
[TOM 951212]

Major Boon - Master Out-of-Turn

* May only be played on a successful bleed (bleed for 1 or
more pool). Only action modifiers and reaction cards
that modify the bleed amount may be played after the
Boon - general action modifiers and reaction cards
cannot be played (e.g., Telepathic Counter and Threats
may be played, but not Deflection) [RTR 951110]
* Cannot be played in succession. The loss from the play
of a Major Boon is due to a card effect, not a bleed. So
a second cannot be played to Boon the first.
[RTR 960530]

Malkavian Prank - Master (Mal)

* The other Methuselahs hold between one and four
counters. This may be in excess of their current pool.
If you guess correctly, they lose that amount and you
gain that amount. If you guess incorrectly, they gain
that amount. [LSJ 971010]

Mariel, Lady Thunder - vampire (Mal) (7)

* If she taps to end combat, the damage is applied just
after the combat ends. :C03: [RTR 970630]

Mask of 1000 Faces - Action Modifier (ob)

* Ignore any skill or "type of minion" requirement of
attempting the action. [RTR 970630]
* Masking a "leave Torpor" action results in neither
Vampire leaving Torpor and no blood cost being paid. If
the action is blocked, the blocking minion cannot commit
diablerie, and combat does not result. [RTR 950906]
* The Mask cannot be used to allow a vampire to take over
an action he is explicitly prohibited from taking.
[RTR 950906]
* The Mask may not be used to take over an inherent action
- one that could only be performed by the acting minion
(e.g., Thadius Zho's special action, or the Muddled
Vampire Hunter's special action). [RTR 951110]
* The action remains the same - the level
(superior/inferior) doesn't change, the target cannot be
changed, any other parameters of the action do not
change, etc. If the action is invalid when it resolves,
then it simply fizzles with no effect (like if a vampire
Masking a superior Govern the Unaligned is not older
than the chosen target). [LSJ 971201]

Masquerade Endangered - Master: Out-of-Turn

* Multiple copies may be played (by different Meth.s)
after a single action, but all would be burned during
the vampire's next untap phase. [TOM 950921]

Protected Resources - Master (2)

* Limits the blood lost to a bleed action to 2 (per
action). It does not reduce the bleed itself, nor does
it nullify a bleed of three or more completely. (So an
Archon Investigation could still be played on a bleed of
four, even though the Methuselah would have only burnt
two pool for the successful bleed). [TOM 960315]

Psyche - Combat (ce)

* The superior will cancel any "continue action" effect
produced during the preceding combat (e.g. Form of Mist)
[RTR 950509]
* No new cost need be paid for the block (Archon, Aching
Beauty, Donal, etc.) [TOM 960303]

Pulled Fangs - Combat

* Is used when a round ends - after presses, or whenever
the round ends (if it is ended prematurely).
[RTR 961113]
* More than one may be played on a Vampire in the same
round. [RTR 950906]
* A vampire not currently entering torpor may play Pulled
Fangs, regardless of whether it would go into torpor
later. [TOM 960531]

Pulse of the Canaille - Action (au) (3)

* Superior should begin with the words, "If this is the
first time Pulse of Canaille has been played on the
acting vampire..." It is not cumulative. [RTR 960530]

Rack, The - Master: Unique Location

* Chooses a vampire *card* - will not automatically target
a new copy of that vampire (if the original is burned or
yielded). [TOM 960122]

Rapid Healing - Action (fo)

* Read as "If this vampire is blocked..." [RTR 941109]

Rat's Warning - Reaction (an)

* Can be used during any bleed attempt made against you,
not just ones declared against you. [RTR 960530]

Scorn of Adonis - Action Modifier (Tor)

* May be played at any time during the voting process, and
will retroactively cause the loss of pool to Methuselahs
voting 'no' before Scorn is played, as well as to
Methuselahs voting 'no' after Scorn is played. :P01:
[RTR 951110]

Smiling Jack the Anarch - Unique Master

* Each other player must burn a pool or a vampire blood
for each counter on Jack. Failing to burn a blood from
an empty vampire will not lessen the obligation.
[LSJ 971212]

Soul Gem of Etrius - Unique Equipment

* A vampire of the same age is treated as if he were
older. That is, if a vampire of the same age is
retrieved from the crypt, it is simply placed into the
uncontrolled area and the Gem burned. [TOM 951030]

Spying Mission - Action Modifier (ob)

* Is only played if you know the bleed is successful,
i.e., after you would normally play action modifiers.
[TOM 960226]
* Is only played after all Reaction cards (as well as
other Action Moifiers) have been played. In particular,
Telepathic Counter no longer 'beats' Spying Mission
unless it is played first (and the bleed is not boosted
back to positive). [TOM 960303]
* The bleed it is played on is considered unsuccessful.
Previous Spying Missions won't be cashed in during that
action. [RTR 960530]

Stake - Equipment: Melee Weapon

* The two points must come from the same stake in order to
Paralyze the victim. If more than one stake is used,
then all stakes dealing more than one damage
(individually) are given to the victim. [TOM 950921]

Sudden Reversal - Master: Out of Turn

* Can burn a Master card that have been played with
Bindusara's ability. [RTR 960708]

Taste of Vitae - combat

* May be played after any strike resolution step, but will
not count blood lost during future strikes in the same
round. [TOM 951217]

Telepathic Counter - reaction (au)

* Is played before the bleed is considered successful, so
would be played before cards like Spying Mission, which
are only played on a successful bleed. [FAQ]

Trap - combat

* Provides one press each round of combat until three
(consecutive) rounds pass with no Methuselah choosing to
play a card. [LSJ 970407]

Vast Wealth - Master

* This action is considered an "equip" action. [RTR]
[RTR 960124]
* Paying for the equipment found is not optional. If
paying the cost will oust the controlling Methuselah,
then she is ousted. [RTR 941109]
* If the equipment cannot be legally placed on the
vampire, it is burned without cost. [RTR]
* Vast Wealth's ability is not usable if the Vampire does
not share the same controller as Vast Wealth.
[RTR 951017]
* Costs are paid for with either pool or minion blood, as
appropriate (VtES card text makes this explicit).
[TOM 951212]

Voter Captivation - Action Modifier (ps)

* Is played *after* the vote is resolved. If the effect of
the vote ousts the acting Methuselah, there is no time
to play Voter Captivation to prevent the ousting.
[RTR 951110]

Wolf Companion - Retainer (an) (1)

* Only does damage at close range. [RTR 941109]
* Does not gain any additional strikes of its controller.
[RTR] [RTR 941109]

Wooden Stake - Equipment

* Tallies damage inflicted over the course of combat.
[RTR 970630]

Zip Gun - Combat

* Ammo cards just modify the strike, not the damage done
to the bearer. [RTR 941109]
* Damage done to the bearer is applied during strike
resolution. [TOM 950919]
* Only deal damage to bearer if bearer uses it during
combat. [LSJ 971215]

Non-Camarilla vampires

* Non-Camarilla vampires cannot become princes or primogen
members. [RTR 951110]
* If a non-Camarilla begins with votes and later gains a
title, he loses the votes he started with, just as if he
had lost a title. [RTR 951110]
* Non-Camarilla vampires cannot call Praxis Seizures,
Justicar Retribution, Command of the Harpies, Masquerade
Enforcement, nor a vote to burn Elysium: the Arboretum.
[RTR 951110]
* Non-Camarilla vampires cannot call Camarilla Exemplary.
[TOM 951227]
* Non-Camarilla vampires cannot call a vote to burn
Masquerade Enforcement. [TOM 960206]
* Non-Camarilla vampires cannot be chosen as an Archon or
Camarilla Exemplary. [RTR 951110]

Inner Circle members

* Inner Circle members are titled (and would lose their
title if they gain another). They derive their votes
from their titles (and would lose the votes with the
title), but the +2 bleed is independent of the title.
[TOM 951217]

Equipments which are Locations (Loquipment)

* Loquipment may be put on any ready minion if moved in an
